property_summary: For any attached value, play() reverts exactly when the value is not 10 wei; when it succeeds with exactly 10 wei, the test contract's Ether balance decreases by exactly 10 wei (it sent 10 and receives either 0 or at most 10 - 1 from the payout).

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `play(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
